title: Abeon Organisation DTO
description:
The organisation record as Auth holds it (FR-12). Auth is the source of truth; every other service holds a projection and refreshes it from `GET /api/v1/internal/auth/orgs/{id}`.

Deliberately NOT `dto/tenant.json`. That one is the switcher entry a browser sees — identity and display only, plus `current`, which is a property of the caller's token rather than of the organisation. This one is the row: it carries `status` and `source_registration_id`, neither of which a browser has any business seeing, and it has no `current` because a service call is not scoped to one.

id.description: Organisation id. Matches the `org_id` claim (ADR-0001) and is the key a projection stores.

name.description: Display name, e.g. "Acme Sp. z o.o.".

status.description: The organisation's own status. A projection MUST treat anything other than `active` as "do not serve this tenant" rather than deleting the row — the states are reversible and the id keeps being referenced.

source_registration_id.description: The registration this organisation was provisioned from (ADR-0022), unique where present. Null for organisations created by other means, and never reused as an alternative key.
